problem.statement_latex: Given a planar graph $G=(V,E)$ with specified edge weights, estimate its multivariate Tutte polynomial $Z_G(q,\{v_e\})=\sum_{A\subseteq E}q^{k(A)}\prod_{e\in A}v_e$ to additive $\varepsilon$ times the tensor-network operator-norm scale of Aharonov--Arad--Eban--Landau.

quantum.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(|V|+|E|,1/\varepsilon)$ quantum time for the efficiently representable parameter regimes, using a Temperley--Lieb representation and an overlap-estimation circuit.
quantum.headline_text: $\operatorname{poly}(|V|+|E|,1/\varepsilon)$ quantum time for the efficiently representable parameter regimes, using a Temperley–Lieb representation and an overlap-estimation circuit.

classical.headline_latex: $O(2^{|E|}\operatorname{poly}(|V|))$ state-sum evaluation, or width-based tensor contraction, applies generally. The specified complete approximation regimes are $\mathsf{BQP}$-complete. For an implemented $q$-qubit, $g$-gate circuit over a fixed finite algebraic gate set, classical simulation also gives $\min\{O(g2^q),\operatorname{poly}(g)2^{O(w)},\operatorname{poly}(s)2^{O(s/\sqrt{\log s})}\}$. Here $w$ is a contraction width and $s$ is the size of the sparse bounded-fan-in Boolean encoding of scalar path counts at the required precision; gate synthesis and precision contribute to $g,s$.
